tax.standard_deduction.source: IRS Rev. Proc. 2026-35, section 3.15; senior deduction (the $6,000 per person aged 65+, 2025-2028, phase-out 6% above MAGI $75,000/$150,000): One Big Beautiful Bill Act, Pub. L. 119-21 sec. 70103, entered 2026-11-16 from the published terms of the law and awaiting verification against IRS guidance (Cowork)

aca.fpl.source: HHS Annual Update of the HHS Poverty Guidelines, Federal Register 2026-00755
aca.fpl.aca_source: HHS/ASPE 2026 poverty guidelines (2027 coverage) + §36B applicable % (Rev. Proc. 2026-26)

estate.exemption.estate_source: IRS Rev. Proc. 2026-35 section 3.44 (basic exclusion for 2027); IRC sections 2010/2503/2505/1014

benefits.contribution_limits.source: IRS Rev. Proc. 2026-24 (HSA); IRS Notice 2026-66 (read in full) / news release IR-2026-136 of 12 Nov 2026
benefits.contribution_limits.note: All figures are the published 2027 values. 415(c) total $75,000 and the Roth catch-up wage threshold $155,000 are from Notice 2026-66 (the HSA age-55 catch-up is a fixed $1,000 in the statute, IRC 223(b)(3); the threshold is measured on 2026 wages and decides whether 2027 catch-up contributions must be Roth).

ss.bend_points.source: SSA Office of the Chief Actuary, Benefit Formula Bend Points (2027 row: $1,340 / $8,077), read on ssa.gov by Cowork on 2026-11-12 (RESULT-016). The 90% / 32% / 15% rates are statutory.

ss.cola_wagebase_max.source: SSA COLA series (COLA effective December 2026 = 3.6%, applied in 2027) and Contribution and Benefit Base (2027: $192,300), read on ssa.gov by Cowork on 2026-11-12 (RESULT-016). The 2027 maximum benefit at full retirement age is not recorded and carries forward from 2026.

ss.earnings_test.source: SSA Retirement Earnings Test Exempt Amounts (2027 row: $25,560 under full retirement age with $1 withheld per $2 over, $67,920 in the year of reaching it with $1 per $3 over), read on ssa.gov by Cowork on 2026-11-12 (RESULT-016).
